responsibility: Provides the x86 FXSR intrinsic header for saving and restoring the x87/MMX/SSE floating-point state. It conditionally enables the fxsr feature and defines wrappers for _fxsave and _fxrstor, plus 64-bit-specific _fxsave64 and _fxrstor64, exposing these processor-state management instructions through GCC’s general-purpose-register intrinsic interface.
